messages.content: Create at most two reusable medical-image reading skills from this training example. The saved answer/reason may be wrong. Return only JSON {"skills":[{"category":"general or one supplied official category","trigger":"when to apply","steps":["concrete image check","how to distinguish alternatives"]}]}. No case/patient ID, option letter, figure number, patient-specific number, copied question, or rule merely repeating the reference diagnosis. General medical findings are allowed. Skills will only be used on other patients. An empty skills list is allowed.

content.text:
Based on the chest X-ray (Figure 1), which of the following findings is most consistent with the presence of a lymphangioma in the context of this patient’s clinical presentation?  
A) Bilateral pleural effusions with normal diaphragm contour  
B) Right-sided pleural effusion with a smooth elevated diaphragm  
C) Right diaphragm elevation and left diaphragm scalloping without pleural effusion  
D) Left-sided pleural effusion with diaphragm scalloping  
E) Normal diaphragm position with right-sided pleural effusion  
F) Bilateral diaphragm elevation with smooth contours
